title: El Aeropuerto
subtitle: The Airport
premise: You land at Aeropuerto Internacional Benito Juárez. Customs is a maze of red and green lights, officials with clipboards, and questions you don't understand. Your declaration form has a mistake.
setting: AICM Terminal 1, international arrivals. Long lines, the smell of industrial cleaner, officials in beige uniforms. The tension of not knowing if you've done something wrong.

characters.name: Sofía
characters.personality: Professional, precise, but has a warm side she rarely shows on duty

characters.name: Carlos
characters.role: Mexican-American returning home, speaks both languages
characters.personality: Casual, immediately friendly, offers help without being asked

arc: Red light at customs → Sofía asks questions → Confusion about the form → Carlos steps in to explain → Form corrected → Waved through, Carlos gives city tips
